topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The house looms large, its silence a heavy blanket that smothers the cheers from my distant life. I stand beside my sister, the key cold in my grip, a reminder of the weight we now carry. Each step inside feels like a tread back in time, the air thick with memories and the quiet whispers of what used to be. The walls, once warm with laughter, now echo with the aftershocks of loss. I cling to the familiarity of the rooms, yet every shadow seems to stretch, every creak a warning. Together, we must sift through years of collected lives, deciding what to keep, what to let go. The task ahead feels endless, and I find myself pausing, looking to my sister for strength, wondering how we will ever fill this new, vast emptiness.
